title: 轻轻放松一只脚
description: 成人在低墙大把手上，以一脚主要承重，另一脚轻触邻近大点。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult pauses on a low slab wall with most weight over one broad foothold while the opposite toe lightly touches a neighboring large hold. Both hands stay secure on generous jugs, and both shoes remain close to the padded floor. Keep the hips balanced rather than leaning far outward. A frontal diagonal view shows the light contact of the second foot and a clearly available oversized step-down hold. Use a painterly oil-pastel illustration with broken strokes, strong volume, a dusty pink and petrol-blue palette, and inviting natural light. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
